item: R826 stage 3a: the segment writer core (range ids, rollover, generation number, hot-journal rollback), behind the off switch
summary: The one open segment is opened for writing through the app's factory after every reader check, read-only first; ids come from the segment's own counter in the same transaction as the rows, a full segment rolls over (size doubling every 16 files, at most 64), and memory temp only. Each commit raises a generation number in the file first and the registry second, so a crash between them is recovered and only an older copy of a file is refused. A hot journal is rolled back before a read while writes are on; with the switch off such a segment reads unreadable and nothing is written. corpus_segments.generation is nullable with no backfill (migration plus boot self-heal). Writing stays behind an off switch nothing turns on, and no app write site uses the writer before stage 4.
